attchmntText: Pursuant to Regulations 30 and 33 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (''SEBI Listing Regulations''), the Board of Directors of the Company, at its Meeting held today i.e. 14th November, 2026, have approved, inter-alia, the following: Financial Results - Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results of the Company for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026. A copy of Unaudited Financial Results and the Limited Review Report received from the Independent Auditors for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026 are enclosed herewith.
voiceSummary: GFL Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on 14th November 2026. The Board approved the Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The company reported a loss of 829 Lakhs for the quarter ended 30th September 2026, compared to a profit of 46 Lakhs in the same period last year. For the half year ended 30th September 2026, the loss was 799 Lakhs, versus a profit of 91 Lakhs previously. The loss for the quarter included an exceptional item of 808 Lakhs due to a loss on the buyback of equity shares of associate PVR INOX Limited. The company also noted that the Scheme of Merger with wholly owned subsidiary INOX Infrastructure Limited became effective from 1st April 2026.

attchmntText: We wish to inform that on Friday, November 13, 2026 Company have filed Form INC-28, accordingly the scheme shall become effective from today i.e., Friday, November 13, 2026.
voiceSummary: GFL Limited intimates that the Scheme of Merger by Absorption of INOX Infrastructure Limited with GFL Limited has become effective on November 13, 2026, with effect from the Appointed Date of April 1, 2026. The Companies filed the certified true copy of the National Company Law Tribunal order along with the Scheme with the Register of Companies via Form INC-28 on November 13, 2026. Consequently, INOX Infrastructure Limited is dissolved without being wound up. The authorized share capital of GFL Limited is increased to INR 70,00,00,000 divided into 70,00,00,000 equity shares of INR 1 each. The Memorandum of Association is amended accordingly.

attchmntText: The Board of Directors of GFL Limited took note of the order Pronounced by Hon'ble National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT) through Circular Resolution. The Board further approved the filing Form INC-28.
